scope: Read-only evaluation of revised expression with synthetic variance inputs; not deployed

checks.query:
EVALUATE ROW("unknown",VAR V = BLANK()
			RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE(), ISBLANK ( V ), BLANK (), V >= 0, "Spend within budget", V >= -0.05, "Spend over budget up to 5%", "Spend over budget above 5%" ),"zero_budget_gap",VAR V = 0
			RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE(), ISBLANK ( V ), BLANK (), V >= 0, "Spend within budget", V >= -0.05, "Spend over budget up to 5%", "Spend over budget above 5%" ),"under_budget",VAR V = 0.5
			RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE(), ISBLANK ( V ), BLANK (), V >= 0, "Spend within budget", V >= -0.05, "Spend over budget up to 5%", "Spend over budget above 5%" ),"small_overrun",VAR V = -0.03
			RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE(), ISBLANK ( V ), BLANK (), V >= 0, "Spend within budget", V >= -0.05, "Spend over budget up to 5%", "Spend over budget above 5%" ),"boundary",VAR V = -0.05
			RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE(), ISBLANK ( V ), BLANK (), V >= 0, "Spend within budget", V >= -0.05, "Spend over budget up to 5%", "Spend over budget above 5%" ),"larger_overrun",VAR V = -0.0501
			RETURN SWITCH ( TRUE(), ISBLANK ( V ), BLANK (), V >= 0, "Spend within budget", V >= -0.05, "Spend over budget up to 5%", "Spend over budget above 5%" ))
